Contract Generator.contract:
Contract GenerateLoanLetterAndAgreementModule::genereateApprovalLetter(id: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		obs: Set(LoanRequest) = LoanRequest.allInstance()->select(o|o.RequestID = id)
	precondition:
		obs.size()>0
	postcondition:
		let newLetter: ApprovalLetter in
		newLetter.oclIsNew() and
		newLetter.Content = 'ApprovalLetterContent' and
		obs.AttachedApprovalLetter = newLetter and
		CurrentLoanRequest = obs and
		result = true
}
